blurb: A cookie name is an RFC 6265 token: letters, digits and a few punctuation characters, with no space, `=`, `;`, `,` or quote. A browser would drop or misread anything else. The default, `__Host-session`, is always legal.
example:
actor User { auth = SignedCookie(secret = "SESSION_KEY", ttl = 12.hours, cookie = "my session"), identity = UserId }   // ✗

actor User { auth = SignedCookie(secret = "SESSION_KEY", ttl = 12.hours), identity = UserId }   // ✓
summary: A `SignedCookie` `cookie` is not a legal cookie name.
